skill.name: nerdzao-elite
skill.description: Guides an AI assistant through a senior engineering and product design workflow with planning, architecture, TDD, clean code, validation, and UX review.
skill.summary: Apply a senior software engineering workflow with architecture, tests, clean code, and UX validation.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Static analysis reported no suspicious patterns in the single prompt file. I found no semantic evidence of prompt injection, data exfiltration, executable code, network access, or filesystem abuse.

content.value_statement: Complex product work often misses planning, tests, architecture, or visual validation. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through a senior delivery workflow.
actual_capabilities: Defines a mandatory workflow that starts with planning and brainstorming.
Prompts for architecture review before implementation.
Requires test-driven development and testing pattern use.
Emphasizes clean code, refactoring, linting, and validation.
Adds product design and visual UX validation for frontend work.
limitations: It is a prompt-only workflow and does not execute tests or linters itself.
It depends on the host assistant having the referenced skills or equivalent behavior.
It is written mainly for Portuguese (Brazil) interactions.
It cannot guarantee pixel-perfect results without rendered UI inspection.

use_cases.title: Plan Product Features
use_cases.description: Create a structured plan before implementation, including architecture, tests, validation, and final review.

use_cases.title: Improve Frontend Quality
use_cases.description: Apply UX checks, visual consistency review, and cleanup expectations during interface work.

use_cases.title: Review Delivery Readiness
use_cases.description: Guide a final pass across clean code, tests, linting, product quality, and production readiness.

prompt_templates.title: Start a Simple Task
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a small implementation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use nerdzao-elite for this task. Plan first, define the architecture, write tests, implement cleanly, validate, and summarize the result.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Frontend Screen
prompt_templates.prompt: Use nerdzao-elite to design and build this screen. Include planning, UX decisions, test coverage, visual validation, and final production review.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor Existing Code
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for improving an existing module.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use nerdzao-elite to refactor this module. Start with risk analysis, propose architecture changes, add tests, clean the code, and validate behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Deliver a Production Feature
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for end-to-end feature delivery.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use nerdzao-elite for full delivery. Produce a plan, architecture, TDD approach, implementation steps, UX validation, production audit, and verification summary.

output_examples.input: Plan a dashboard redesign with this workflow.
output: A short implementation plan with product goals and constraints.
Architecture notes for components, state, data loading, and tests.
A validation checklist covering UI consistency, accessibility, and production readiness.

output_examples.input: Use this skill to refactor a brittle checkout flow.
output: A risk review of the current checkout flow.
A TDD sequence for preserving behavior while improving structure.
A final review summary with tests, linting, and remaining risks.

output_examples.input: Apply this skill to a new product feature.
output: A staged delivery plan from discovery through verification.
Architecture choices linked to product and user experience goals.
A production readiness summary with validation results.

best_practices: Provide the feature goal, current constraints, and acceptance criteria before invoking the workflow.
Include relevant files or screenshots when asking for UX validation.
Ask for explicit verification results after implementation.
anti_patterns: Do not use it as a replacement for real test execution.
Do not request pixel-perfect validation without a rendered interface or screenshot.
Do not skip planning when the task changes scope.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It guides an assistant through a senior engineering workflow with planning, architecture, TDD, clean code, UX validation, and review.

faq.question: Does it run tests automatically?
faq.answer: No. It prompts the assistant to use tests and validation, but tool execution depends on the host environment.

faq.question: Which tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Is it only for frontend work?
faq.answer: No. It covers general software delivery and adds stronger guidance for frontend UX validation.

faq.question: What language does it target?
faq.answer: The skill text is primarily Portuguese (Brazil), with marketplace content written in English.

faq.question: Is this skill safe to install?
faq.answer: It is prompt-only and static analysis found no executable code, network access, or filesystem operations.
